SELECT j.job_id as jobId, j.comp_id as compId, u.company_name as comName, j.title, j.field, CASE WHEN j.exp_year = '0' OR j.exp_year LIKE '%신입%' THEN '신입' ELSE '경력' END as expYear, j.edu, j.address, j.close_date as closeDate FROM JOB_POSTING j JOIN USER_COMPANY u ON j.comp_id = u.user_id
AND (j.exp_type = 'new' OR j.exp_year = '0')
AND j.exp_type = 'career'
AND (
j.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%') OR j.field LIKE CONCAT('%', #{item}, '%') )
AND j.edu = '학력무관'
AND (j.edu = #{eduType} OR j.edu = '학력무관')
ORDER BY j.job_id DESC
